landing.eyebrow: A little space for your whole musical world
landing.intro: Bring your files, favourite links and favourite people together. Leave a little room to breathe.

landing.previewNote: The real web app, ready for your music.
landing.previewAlt: GlukWave player with Forss in the Paper theme
landing.benefitIntro: A listening space built around you, from the first file to the last late-night track.
landing.libraryText: Upload your own audio, keep favourites and organise playlists. Compatible source links play through official players.
landing.togetherText: Open a listening room, invite your people and choose what comes next together.
landing.spaceText: Light or dark, your own colours, living waves and quiet Lo-Fi landscapes. Your settings follow your account.
landing.platformIntro: The browser is ready now. Available app builds appear here as they are released.
landing.releaseError: Couldn't check downloads. Please try again.
landing.faqOfflineA: Your own audio files can be saved on your device. Official players from external services need a connection and follow that service's rules.
landing.faqAccountA: Explore first. Sign in to keep your library, playlists, settings and listening rooms together across devices.
landing.faqSourcesA: GlukWave keeps links to external tracks and opens their official players. Availability, full-track access and account restrictions come from each source.
landing.metaDescription: A personal listening space for your audio files, playlists and people. Open GlukWave in your browser or get an available app build.
